art_note: The imagery relies on generic supplier composites with flat cutout styling, failing to meet luxury e-commerce standards.
desc_en: This sleeveless midi dress combines a fluid silhouette with contemporary design. Crafted from premium polyester with a subtle texture offering softness and comfort for everyday wear. It features a graceful V-shaped neckline and an elastic waistband that enhances the natural shape. Designed with two large front side pockets for refined practicality. A versatile piece available made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Este vestido midi sin mangas combina una silueta fluida con un diseño contemporáneo. Confeccionado en poliéster de primera calidad con una textura sutil que aporta suavidad y confort para el uso diario. Presenta un favorecedor escote en V y una cintura elástica que define la figura con elegancia. Incorpora dos amplios bolsillos laterales delanteros para mayor funcionalidad. Una pieza versátil disponible bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
